import numpy as np
def equation(t, x, v, params):
    p = params
    return (p[0]*np.sqrt(v) + p[1]*np.exp(-v) + p[2]*x*v**1.5 + p[3]*x**2/v
            + p[4]*x**2*np.sqrt(v) + p[5]*x**3/v + p[6]*np.cos(x)/v
            + p[7]*np.cos(x)*np.log(v) + p[8]*np.cos(x)*np.sqrt(v) + p[9]*np.sin(x))
